messages:
Maya: Pasting customer report — rerank call returns 413 / "Request entity too large" when they send a Japanese query + ~120 docs. payload size ~1.1MB.
Customer (Acme): Hi, our /v1/rerank returns 413. We send "query": "ユーザーの質問..." and docs=[{id, text},...]. We tried trimming but still failing. Body: {"error":"Request entity too large"}. We need urgent help, this breaks search ranking.
Maya: Got it. @Ashley @Sam can you triage? Ask them for model name and exact payload (sanitized) + whether they're using 'passages' or raw docs.
Ashley: Likely token-ceiling hit: rerank counts query tokens + sum(doc tokens. CJK tokenization can increase token count vs chars. If they send full docs (long articles) 120 docs adds up fast.
Ashley: Quick repro checklist: model, exact request size, whether there's base64 attachments, and if they're hitting a per-request token limit or server payload limit (proxy/nginx) — both possible.
Maya: I asked customer for the exact error body and model. Meanwhile suggest workaround.
Customer (Acme): Error body: {"status":413,"message":"Request entity too large"}. Model: rwd-llm-32k-v1 (we're on hosted). We use docs[].text fields, each ~2-5k chars.
Sam: If they're on a 32k model, token limit per inference may still be enforced for rerank endpoint. Rerank aggregates all doc tokens + query. Suggest they prefilter with embeddings to reduce to ~20 candidates.
Maya: Can you paste a tiny chunking example we can share?
Sam: Sure — sample curl to split into chunks client-side and call rerank for each chunk of 25 docs then merge scores:
```bash
# pseudo example
curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-rerank-v1","query":"ユーザーの質問...","documents": [ ...first 25 docs... ]}'
```
Sam: Also recommend first run an embedding search to pick top-K candidates. That reduces tokens dramatically.
Ashley: For UX/NRT: error message is too vague. We should return a token_count field and which field blew past the limit (query vs docs) so customers don't have to guess.
Maya: I'll open a docs/update request and propose adding a "request_tokens" field in the 4xx error response and a KB entry showing token accounting and chunking patterns.
SupportBot: Created INC-9821 — rerank token-clarity. Assigned to eng.
Ashley: Another note: some customers include full HTML or markdown in docs — stripping markup reduces token count. Suggest they send a plain-text snippet field (summary) for reranking.
Maya: I'll share all recommendations back to customer and ask for smallest repro (one query + subset of docs) we can run here. Also ask whether they need real-time single-call guarantees or can accept multi-phase flow (embed -> topK -> rerank).
Customer (Acme): Thanks, will try prefilter + trim and send a repro if still failing.
Maya: Marking for follow-up. If we get repro, we can reproduce locally and suggest adding token-info to error.
Ashley: Filing follow-up PR to add more explicit error payload and KB article.
Maya: Closing loop once customer confirms. :thumbsup:
